fichas.title: High-rise buildings: requirements
fichas.summary: Overview of high-rise building requirements focused on structural layout and fire protection. Covers height-based regulations, escape routes, emergency stairs, lift grouping and fire service lifts, façade fire protection, and cleaning of inaccessible windows. Specific requirements are subject to state and local regulations.
uses: Provide protected escape routes and emergency stairs
Organize lift service for buildings of different heights
Clean exterior window areas that cannot be safely reached from inside
